title: Row.containsKey identity fast path
impact: Routes `Row.containsKey` through the exp 158 schema-name identity scan (via a shared `RowSchema.containsName`) instead of always hashing the key in the private `HashMap`. For interned-key probes on schemas ≤ 32 columns the membership test becomes a pointer-identity scan; equal-but-non-identical keys and wider schemas still fall back to the map. Focused `row_map_facade` `containsKey` lane improves **~13.0 → ~10.0 ms (−23%)** with a flat `hot lookup` control, flipping Row from ~+3.6 ms slower than `LinkedHashMap` to at-parity. Behavior-identical, no public API change
